card.name: Start of a split medical word
card.fires_on: The first piece of a longer word that is split into parts, such as Rhe(umatoid), Dil(ute), sed(ating), perimen(opausal), and Gote(borg). It is common right after a DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION heading.

modes.label: Section-start word
modes.description: The first piece of a word that opens a dosing subsection after the heading.
modes.example: 2 DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION<< Dil>>ute prior to administration.

modes.label: Mid-word in clinical terms
modes.description: A middle or opening piece inside words like sedating or perimenopausal.
